title: PeriodRecordsChangedPayload
description: Payload of the PeriodRecordsChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml; class: domain; INV-Q-16535 A). Carries the complete set of period records in force of the entity (a superseded record is absent), earliest periodStart first. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity whose period records changed.

version.description: Version of the entity's period records; a consumer ignores an event whose version is not above the one it holds (idempotent consumer by version).

periods.description: The complete set of period records in force of the entity, earliest periodStart first.
